verdict.rationale: Openness is a fair question for a GPU, since buyers often ask about open-source drivers, firmware or hardware designs. Nothing in the pack shows the RTX PRO 6000's own source, drivers or firmware available under an open license. Mentions of the open-source NeMo framework and a separate open-source 5G/6G library describe other NVIDIA software, not this product's source, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
